field_notes.source: 'Base game', 'Shadow of the Erdtree' (DLC) or 'Tarnished Pack' (DLC), from the DLC icon next to the item in the wiki gallery.
field_notes.summary: Opening paragraph of the wiki page (often contains exact values, e.g. talisman percentages).
field_notes.effect / effect_details / effect_tables: Infobox effect line + content of the page's Effect/Usage sections.
field_notes.infobox: All infobox fields of the page, cleaned (numbers parsed when purely numeric).
field_notes.acquisition: method / location / region / details from the Acquisition section; nested bullets prefixed with '→'.
field_notes.other_sections: Remaining gameplay sections (text bullets and tables); Trivia/Gallery/References are excluded.

items.name: Sliver of Meat
items.summary: Sliver of Meat is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A slice of thinly carved beast flesh. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.

The dried meat toughens the constitution.

infobox.required_for: Dappled Cured Meat; Invigorating Cured Meat

items.name: Strip of White Flesh
items.summary: Strip of White Flesh is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature. Material used for crafting items.

The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It's known for its long-lasting effect.

details: Land Octopus

infobox.obtained: Found by hunting creatures [sic] bloodless creatures
infobox.required_for: Dappled White Cured Meat; Invigorating White Cured Meat

items.name: Beast Liver
items.summary: Beast Liver is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The fresh liver of a beast; a luscious fruit of life. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.

Dried liver boosts damage negation.

details: Dropped by herbivorous animals with an 8% droprate:
→ Sheep are found in large quantities between the Church of Pilgrimage and Witchbane Ruins, in the Weeping Peninsula.
→ Deer are commonly found in upper and lower Siofra River, where they roam freely.
→ Springhares are found throughout Limgrave.

infobox.required_for: Fireproof Dried Liver; Holyproof Dried Liver; Lightningproof Dried Liver; Spellproof Dried Liver

items.name: Lump of Flesh
items.summary: Lump of Flesh is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A lump of beast flesh filled with rich juices. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beasts.

Meat suitable for a rustic feast.

details: Bears
Boars
Wolves
Dogs
Lesser Runebears

items.name: Turtle Neck Meat
items.summary: Turtle Neck Meat is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A splendid, lengthy cut of turtle neck meat. Material used for crafting items.

Considered an especially nutritious ingredient In [sic] the south of the Lands Between.

details: A 100% drop from any Turtle.
x12 drop from Miriel, Pastor of Vows if killed.
x2 are found on a corpse in Gaol Cave.
One is found on a corpse located at a campsite in Altus Plateau.
An unlimited stock can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing.

infobox.obtained: Turtles / Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks / Loot
infobox.required_for: Pickled Turtle Neck

items.name: Beast Blood
items.summary: Beast Blood is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Fresh beast blood, glinting with gold. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beasts.

This glimmering blood never rots or decays.

infobox.required_for: Dragonwound Grease

items.name: Albinauric Bloodclot
items.japanese_name: しろがねの凝血 (Shirogane no Gyōketsu)
items.summary: Albinauric Bloodclot is an item used for crafting in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The thick, coagulated blood of the Albinaurics.
Material used for crafting items.

Albinaurics are lifeforms made by human hands.
Thus, many believe them to live impure lives, untouched by the Erdtree's grace.

text: These can be farmed efficiently by killing the first-generation Albinaurics near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace.

items.name: Budding Horn
items.summary: Budding Horn is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A rarely-seen specimen of a young, budding horn. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.

This horn began to sprout on a beast that typically bears no horn. Perhaps it's a vestige of the primordial crucible.

infobox.required_for: Dappled Cured Meat; Dappled White Cured Meat

items.name: Old Fang
items.summary: Old Fang is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A rarely-seen specimen of beast fang. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beasts.

These multiple, overlapping fangs grow from a single root. Perhaps they're a vestige of the primordial crucible.

items.name: Flight Pinion
items.summary: Flight Pinion is a crafting material dropped by birds in Elden Ring. Flight Pinions are used in crafting recipes to fletch certain types of arrows, allowing them to fly further.
items.description:
Flight feather of a bird of prey.

Material used for crafting items.

Commonly used for arrow fletchings.

infobox.required_for: Bone Arrow (Fletched); Bloodbone Arrow (Fletched); Firebone Arrow (Fletched); Poisonbone Arrow (Fletched)

items.name: Stormhawk Feather
items.summary: Stormhawk Feather is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A feather from a hawk that lived as one with the storms. Material used for crafting items.

These feathers, enveloped in swirling winds, are often used for arrow fletching.

items.name: Four-Toed Fowl Foot
items.japanese_name: 四指の鳥脚 (Yon Yubi no Toriashi)
items.summary: Four-Toed Fowl Foot is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A four-toed fowl's foot. Material used for crafting items.

In the Lands Between, having three digits is seen as a bad omen. As such, the four-toed fowl's foot is a gift of great luck indeed.

details: ===Drops===
===Farming===

More than 10 of the ideal farming target, Guillemots, can be found on the beach west and northwest of the Fourth Church of Marika in western Weeping Peninsula. Using something silent like the sorcery Freezing Mist or the skill Chilling Mist, or a Bow or Light Bow is ideal since the many birds are likely to take off when alerted.

infobox.required_for: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot; Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot

items.name: Slumbering Egg
items.summary: Slumbering Egg is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items.

Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.
effect_details: Used for crafting in the following recipes:

details: Owls

items.name: Crab Eggs
items.summary: Crab Eggs is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Eggs of large crabs which dwell in the shallows. Material used for crafting items.

A nutritious foodstuff that warms from within. The flavor is exquisite. Only those of comfort and means know the truth: a crab's eggs are more delectable than its meat.

infobox.required_for: Invigorating Cured Meat; Invigorating White Cured Meat

items.name: Land Octopus Ovary
items.summary: Land Octopus Ovary is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Puffy, milky white ovary of a land octopus. Material used for crafting items.

Land octopuses eat humans in order to bear young, and theirs is the blood that runs through these ovaries.

details: Land Octopus

infobox.required_for: Invigorating Cured Meat; Invigorating White Cured Meat; Stanching Boluses

items.name: Thin Beast Bones
items.summary: Thin Beast Bones is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thin, hard beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting beasts.

Commonly used to make disposable weapons.
notes: This item was originally called "Thin Animal Bones" in the Closed Network Test.

infobox.required_for: Bloodbone Arrow; Bloodbone Arrow (Fletched); Bloodbone Bolt; Bone Arrow; Bone Arrow (Fletched); Bone Bolt; Bone Dart; Firebone Arrow; Firebone Arrow (Fletched); Firebone Bolt; Poisonbone Arrow; Poisonbone Arrow (Fletched); Poisonbone Bolt; Poisonbone Dart; Rainbow Stone Arrow; Shattershard Arrow

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone
items.summary: Hefty Beast Bone is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, solid beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting particularly large beasts.

Commonly used to make disposable weapons.

details: Bears
Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks, for 250 runes each, after giving them Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing

infobox.obtained: Found by hunting particularly large beasts

items.name: Human Bone Shard
items.summary: Human Bone Shard is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Fragment of bone with dun mottling. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death.

Lamentably brittle, it crumbles at the lightest caress.

infobox.obtained: Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death
infobox.required_for: Grace Mimic; Scriptstone

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head
items.japanese_name: 大トンボの頭 (Ōtonbo no Atama)
items.summary: Great Dragonfly Head is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head of a large dragonfly. Material used for crafting items.

Long believed to have the ability to neutralize poisons.

infobox.required_for: Neutralizing Boluses

items.name: Gold Firefly
items.summary: Gold Firefly is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Firefly that gives off a golden light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of water close to Minor Erdtrees.

The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Golden light is considered to invite runes.

infobox.obtained: Found near waters close to Minor Erdtrees
infobox.required_for: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot

items.name: Silver Firefly
items.summary: Silver Firefly is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Firefly that gives off a silvery light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of cold water untouched by sunlight.
The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Silver light is considered to invite riches.

details: Silver fireflies can be found in the following areas:
Ainsel River
Siofra River
Deeproot Depths
Mohgwyn Palace
Earthbore Cave
Groveside Cave
Lakeside Crystal Cave
Academy Crystal Cave
Dragonbarrow Cave
Sellia Hideaway
Coastal Cave
Highroad Cave
Perfumer's Grotto
Sage's Cave
Spiritcaller Cave
Gael Tunnel
In Liurnia of the Lakes, there are three silver fireflies that are not found in caves or underground areas:
Found on the broken bridge south of the Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace.
Found behind the Highway Lookout Tower.
Found on the broken wall on the east side of Frenzy-Flaming Tower.

infobox.obtained: Found near cold waters untouched by sunlight
infobox.required_for: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot

items.name: Glintstone Firefly
items.summary: Glintstone Firefly is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A firefly whose glowing tail has hardened into glintstone, widely found in Liurnia Lake. Material used for crafting items.

Alas, now that its tail is glintstone, it can no longer beguile potential mates.

details: Found near large, blue crystals found in Liurnia of the Lakes and Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.

→ In Liurnia of the Lakes, well over a dozen can be found by heading to the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace near the Village of the Albinaurics and heading southwest. There are some Crystalians throughout the path but it is otherwise largely dangerfree.

→ At the eastern edge of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, south of Lenne's Rise, is a collection of glintstone crystals carrying these Fireflies. Be aware of the large boulder that will spawn behind you if you stray too far down the path.
Dropped by certain sorcery-associated enemies: the sorcerer variant of First-Generation Albinaurics (12%), and the magic pot throwing variant of Imp.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly
items.summary: Smoldering Butterfly is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An eternally burning butterfly found near wildfires and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items.

Serves as the kindling for a number of items.

details: Smoldering Butterflies in the wild are most commonly found around Flame Slugs.
→ North of Warmaster's Shack is a swarm of 8 around 2 Slugs.
→ Southwest of the Eastern Tableland Site of Grace in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes is a Fire Monk camp that contains the gesture Fire Spur Me. In the nearby area are 3 swarms of Butterflies.

infobox.required_for: Drawstring Fire Grease; Fire Grease; Fire Pot; Firebone Arrow; Firebone Arrow (Fletched); Firebone Bolt; Fireproof Dried Liver; Roped Fire Pot; Soft Cotton

items.name: Aeonian Butterfly
items.japanese_name: エオニアの蝶 (Eonia no Chō)
items.summary: Aeonian Butterfly is an item used for crafting in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A butterfly with withered, scarlet wings found in the Swamp of Aeonia.
Material used for crafting items.

According to myth, these butterflies were once the wings of the Goddess of Rot herself.
effect_details: Used for crafting in the following recipes:

details: Aeonian Butterflies can be found in the world, however they do not respawn after dying or resting at a Site of Grace.
===Random Drop===
8.00% chance from Basilisk in the Lake of Rot.
1.50% chance from Kindred of Rot.

infobox.obtained: Found in the Swamp of Aeonia.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly
items.summary: Nascent Butterfly is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An arcane butterfly with translucent wings. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find.

This butterfly appears as if it's just emerged from its cocoon for its entire life.

details: Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x5)

Dropped with a 20% chance by two of the Ancestral Follower Shaman in the Ancestral Woods area of Siofra River. They are found surrounded by rats in the north-west of the area, looking out over the flooded ruins. No other shamans drop the item.

infobox.required_for: Dappled Cured Meat; Dappled White Cured Meat

items.name: Golden Centipede
items.summary: Golden Centipede is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The golden, desiccated remains of a centipede. Material used for crafting items.

Kept as a fetish by Golden Order fundamentalists, especially the hunters of Those Who Live in Death. As such, they are found near churches and similar.

details: Some non-respawnable centipedes are found in areas associated with either Those Who Live in Death or the Golden Order.
→ Two found in Siofra Aqueduct, just before the fog gate to the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss.
→ Found in Siofra Aqueduct in a room hidden behind a waterfall after, also just before the Valiant Gargoyles.
→ Six found near the Minor Erdtree Church, at the base of a large tree.
→ Five found inside of the Church of Pilgrimage.
→ 6 are found hidden around the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.
→ For an earlier spot, there are around 8 near the Minor Erdtree (Caelid). Start from the Minor Erdtree Catacombs Site of Grace for easier access
Drop from the Guardians around Minor Erdtree Church with a 4% droprate, the only respawning method of acquiring this crafting material. No other Guardians drop them.

infobox.obtained: Found near churches and similar; Guardians

items.name: Living Jar Shard
items.japanese_name: 生き壺の破片 (Ikitsubo no Hahen)
items.summary: Living Jar Shard is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A fragment of a living jar, hardened after its death.
Material used for crafting items.

Such fragments command a high price due to the magical power locked within. This leaves the living jars unfortunate targets for poachers.

items.name: Silver Tear Husk
items.summary: Silver Tear Husk is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A hardened husk shed by a formless life form known as the Silver Tear, found in and around the Eternal City.
Material used for crafting items.

The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation.
Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord...

infobox.obtained: Found in and around the Eternal City.

items.name: Gold-Tinged Excrement
items.summary: Gold-Tinged Excrement is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Often hidden in woods and thickets.

Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.

details: Gold-Tinged Excrement is found hidden in forests and thickets throughout the Lands Between.

infobox.obtained: Often hidden in woods and thickets
infobox.required_for: Fetid Pot; Roped Fetid Pot

items.name: Blood-Tainted Excrement
items.japanese_name: 血の混じった排泄物 (Chi no Majitta Haisetsubutsu)
items.summary: Blood-Tainted Excrement is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The bloody excrement of a carnivorous beast.
Material used for crafting items.
Found in the land of the new dynasty.

Mixed inside with half-digested flesh are dense colonies of tiny eggs of unknown but assuredly revolting origin.

infobox.obtained: Found in the land of the new dynasty.

items.name: Yellow Ember
items.summary: Yellow Ember is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An ember taken from the eye socket of a corpse. Material used for crafting items.

A sign that the deceased suffered from the flame of frenzy. This grape has ripened and burst.

infobox.obtained: Found in lands afflicted by frenzy

items.name: Beast Horn
items.summary: Beast Horn is a crafting material in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Horn suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items.

Found by hunting horned beasts of the realm of shadow.

The Crucible has a particularly strong influence on the beasts of the realm of shadow, causing many to grow horns despite the characteristics of their species.

details: Dropped by horned beasts in the Realm of Shadow.

infobox.obtained: Found by hunting horned beasts of the realm of shadow
infobox.required_for: Fingerprint Nostrum; Spritestone; Fire Spritestone; Lulling Branch; Charming Branch

items.name: Spirit Calculus
items.summary: Spirit Calculus is a crafting material in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
An exceedingly rare to find calculus, suffused with spirituality. Material used for crafting items.

Found by hunting horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Has a distinctive acrid odor, which some claim to be a sign of particular spiritual potency.

details: Dropped by horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

infobox.obtained: Found by hunting horned beasts in ancient ruins
infobox.required_for: Spritestone

items.name: Scorpion Liver
items.summary: Scorpion Liver is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Fresh organ of a spider-scorpion. It is referred to as 'liver,' but no one is quite sure of its purpose. Material used for crafting.

Found by hunting spider-scorpions.

A delicacy known for its numbing toxins.

details: Dropped by Spider Scorpions.

infobox.required_for: Spellproof Pickled Liver; Fireproof Pickled Liver; Lightningproof Pickled Liver; Holyproof Pickled Liver; Opaline Pickled Liver; Well-Pickled Turtle Neck

items.name: Fly Mold
items.summary: Fly Mold is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A species of fungus known for its deathly sweet stench. Material used for crafting.

Found by hunting man-flies.

Cultivated using the flesh and blood of man-flies, it can serve as pot innards.

details: Dropped by man-flies.

infobox.required_for: Hefty Poison Pot; Hefty Fetid Pot; Hefty Rot Pot; Hefty Fly Pot

items.name: Pearlescent Scale
items.japanese_name: 真珠色のウロコ (Shinjuiro no Uroko)
items.summary: Beast Horn is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A glassy and glistening fragment of pearlescent hue. Material used for crafting items.

Found by hunting lamprey.

These retrograde scales are found embedded deep within the skin of lamprey.

details: Dropped by lamprey in the Finger Ruins of Rhia and Dheo.

infobox.required_for: Opaline Pickled Liver; Glinting Nail; Fingerprint Nostrum

items.name: Ember of Messmer
items.japanese_name: メスメルの残り火 (Mesumeru no Nokoribi)
items.summary: Ember of Messmer is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Serpentine, cord-like ember. Material used for crafting.

Mainly found in Scadu Altus.

A remnant of Messmer's flame, the symbol of the crusade, it continues to smolder as if crawling across the ground.

details: Dropped by Messmerfire dogs or found on the ground in Messmer Soldier camps.

infobox.required_for: Hefty Furnace Pot; Fire Spritestone; Fire Coil

items.name: Black Pyrefly
items.summary: Black Pyrefly is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings.
Material used for crafting items.

Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame.

They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire.

details: Several can be found in Scorched Ruins. Dropped by Shadow Commoners in Gravesite Plain.

infobox.obtained: Flies in burnt and war-torn lands
infobox.required_for: Hefty Fire Pot; Sunwarmth Stone; Fireproof Pickled Liver; Messmerfire Grease; Drawstring Messmerfire Grease

items.name: Glintslab Firefly
items.summary: Glintslab Firefly is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Glintstone firefly improved by selective breeding. Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found near Manus Metyr.

The glintstone that produces its light has become freakishly enlarged, while the span of its life is as brief as a whisper.

details: Found in Castle Ensis and in the lake around the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

infobox.required_for: Royal Magic Grease; Drawstring Royal Magic Grease; Hefty Magic Pot; Spellproof Pickled Liver

items.name: Toxic Mossling
items.summary: Toxic Mossling is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A large moss animal glutted with poison. Material used for crafting items.

Found in poison swamps.

Round and plump, like a darling infant.

details: Found in poison swamps around the Realm of Shadow, such as beyond the Belurat well depths and the path to the Rauh Base.

infobox.required_for: Hefty Poison Pot

items.name: Frozen Maggot
items.summary: Frozen Maggot is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Frozen maggots that somehow continue to wriggle. Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found in gaols.

The maggots develop in great-jar innards, and are an invaluable source of sustenance to the prisoners.

details: Found in the Belurat Gaol, Lamenter's Gaol and Bonny Gaol. Also dropped by the Shadow Prisoners.

infobox.required_for: Hefty Freezing Pot

items.name: Winter-Lantern Fly
items.summary: Winter-Lantern Fly is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Winged insect carrying a dangling frenzied flame grape. Material used for crafting items.

Flies lazily around the abyssal forest.

Said to be heralds of the aging untouchables. On seeing these, the wise know to stay well clear of that place.

details: Found in the Abyssal Woods.

infobox.obtained: Flies lazily around the abyssal forest
infobox.required_for: Frenzied Flame Pot; Roped Frenzied Flame Pot; Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot

items.name: Grave Cricket
items.summary: Grave Cricket is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Cricket that produces a raspy cry. Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found near stone coffins.

The sound of these crickets are often taken to be the rustling of the restless dead, or sometimes the sound of their calling voices.

details: Found in Charo's Hidden Grave and around stone coffins on the Cerulean Coast.

infobox.required_for: Call of Tibia; Polter Stone

items.name: Grave Keeper's Brainpan
items.summary: Grave Keeper's Brainpan is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Skull bone of an old grave keeper. Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo.

The old grave keepers are boatsmen, and continue to summon the dead even after withering away.

details: Found scattered around Charo's Hidden Grave.

infobox.obtained: Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo
infobox.required_for: Call of Tibia

items.name: Congealed Putrescence
items.summary: Congealed Putrescence is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bruise-colored putrescence that oozes from stone coffins, congealed into a large viscous lump. Material used for crafting items.

Found underground in the land to where stone coffins drift.

The putrescence is what remains of the impure lives kept within the stone coffins.

details: Found on the ground in the Stone Coffin Fissure or dropped by Putrescence Slimes.

infobox.obtained: Found underground in the land to where stone coffins drift
infobox.required_for: Piquebone Arrowx10; Piquebone Arrow (Fletched)x10; Piquebone Boltx5

items.name: Blessed Bone Shard
items.summary: Blessed Bone Shard is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Shard of bone with a golden shine. Material used to craft items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

A bone fragment touched by the gold of the Scadutree, broken from the remains of the warriors who perished in the realm of shadow. A blessing such as this is said to be the greatest honor that can be granted to the dead.

details: Blessed bone shards can only be harvested once per playthrough.
Rarely dropped by Black Knights and Messmer Soldiers.

infobox.required_for: Sunwarmth Stone; Festive Grease; Golden Vow

items.name: Horn-Strewn Excrement
items.japanese_name: 角混じりの排泄物 (Tsunomajiri no Haisetsubutsu)
items.summary: Horn-Strewn Excrement is a crafting material in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Excrement of a large carnivorous beast containing fragments of horns. Material used for crafting items.

Found underfoot in places like forests where beasts dwell.

It is said that the deadliest of the horned predators enjoy the sport of hunting and devouring other horned creatures.

details: Horn-Tinged Excrement is found in the forests at the northern Rauh Base.

infobox.obtained: Found underfoot in places like forests where beasts dwell
infobox.required_for: Hefty Fetid Pot

items.name: Swollen Grape
items.summary: Swollen Grape is a crafting material in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
An eyeball of the frenzied flame that has swollen from within. Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

Marked with fingerprint burns, proof of having being touched directly by the Three Fingers' embrace.

details: Found as loot and dropped by Aging Untouchables.

infobox.required_for: Surging Frenzied Flame

items.name: Rowa Fruit
items.summary: Rowa Fruit is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Berry-like red fruits that grow in shrubs. Material used for crafting items.

Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between, it has a wide variety of uses.

details: An early farming point is at The First Step site of grace in Limgrave, where some can be found in the nearby bushes.
A more efficient farming spot can be found at Jarburg, where Tarnished Golden Sunflowers, Grave Violets, Poisonbloom, Erdleaf Flowers, and Crystal Buds also can be found.

infobox.obtained: Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between
infobox.required_for: Exalted Flesh; Fireproof Dried Liver; Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot; Immunizing Cured Meat; Immunizing White Cured Meat; Pickled Turtle Neck; Rowa Raisin; Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot; Soft Cotton; Spellproof Dried Liver

items.name: Golden Rowa
items.summary: Golden Rowa is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A Rowa fruit tinted with gold. Material used for crafting items.

Easily found near the Erdtree.

details: Essentially Altus Plateau's equivalent of the regular Rowa Fruit, it can be found in similar spots (bushes).
→ Around Mirage Rise, west-southwest of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau), are a fair amount as well as in between the Rise and the Bower of Bounty site of grace a bit further east.
→ The valley in between Erdtree Gazing Hill site of grace and the Golden Lineage Evergaol, especially under the bridge just before the Gaol, holds some as well.

infobox.required_for: Dappled Cured Meat; Dappled White Cured Meat; Invigorating Cured Meat; Invigorating White Cured Meat

items.name: Rimed Rowa
items.summary: Rimed Rowa is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A berry-like fruit, thought to be the original strain of Rowa. Material used for crafting items. Found in frigid highlands.

items.name: Fulgurbloom
items.summary: Fulgurbloom is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Yellow flower that grows in lightning-struck lands. Material used for crafting items.

Imbued with traces of lightning's essence.

details: Fulgurbloom grows abundantly in spots where lightning strikes regularly. This is most common in Altus Plateau but there are also some spots in Limgrave and Mountaintops of the Giants.
→ In Limgrave, 14 flowers can be found early on the hill just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace or east of the Gatefront site of grace.
→ In Liurnia, 14 can be found in the waters east of Tetsu's Rise. Lightning striking the water is likely to deal minor damage.

→ In Altus Plateau, the largest collection of 27 flowers, with 3 groups of 10, 8, and 9 flowers, can be found near the Rampartside Path site of grace, east of the Sainted Hero's Grave. Head west from the Grace for the first group and then head south for the second. Go northeast to get up on the hill just south of the Grace itself for the third group. Be aware that Ancient Dragon Lansseax spawns very close to the route.
→ In East Dragonbarrow, 10 flowers can be found near the road between Minor Erdtree and the Farum Greatbridge.
→ At Castle Sol in Mountaintops of the Giants, there is a small field of them just west of the Castle Sol Main Gate site of grace.

Also dropped by certain lightning-infused enemies found in Altus Plateau and Leyndell, Royal Capital. Specifically Lightning Sheep (20%), and lightning pot-throwing Imps (10%) and Leyndell Soldiers (5%).

notes: Lightning that strikes around fields of Fulgurbloom can hit player and does 30-43 damage.

Said to be a funereal flower in an era long past, before the Erdtree grew.

details: Grows in the Altus Plateau.
8% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Perfumers.
15% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Depraved Perfumers.

infobox.required_for: Bloodboil Aromatic; Poison Spraymist; Spark Aromatic; Uplifting Aromatic

items.name: Bloodrose

items.description:

Particularly beloved by those who serve the Lord of Blood. Glory to his inevitable reign.

details: Bloodrose can be harvested throughout the Lands Between.
→ Fort Haight
→ Rose Church
Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from Imprisoned Merchant at the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 800 Runes each.

A purple flower that blooms in graveyards. Material used for crafting items.

Jarburg
Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

items.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower
items.summary: Tarnished Golden Sunflower is a crafting material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A large flower that blooms facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.

Though wilted and faded, it still retains holy essence.

details: Most commonly found around Minor Erdtrees in Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes (northeast), and Caelid.
→ The Minor Erdtree (Limgrave), located in Mistwood, has many of these flowers around it and is not guarded by an Erdtree Avatar or Guardians.

→ Another location is in the Weeping Peninsula, found in an open field beneath a broken wall north of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace or southwest of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace. Be cautious of a Deathbird that spawns at night here, but the Holy Water Pot crafted from this material can aid in defeating it.
→ Jarburg holds many of these, along with various other plants.
Guardians have a 4% chance to drop this item.

infobox.required_for: Holy Water Pot; Roped Holy Water Pot

A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.

At the foot of the Erdtree, they retain their color, along with a powerful holy essence.

details: Found near Minor Erdtrees in the Altus Plateau. Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) has the highest concentration, though a decent amount can also be found around the Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts).
The only known enemy to drop this item is a variant of Wandering Nobles that carries the Noble's Estoc and Aristocrat Hat (8% drop rate).

text: Trina's Lilies are used in the creation of a myriad of sleep-inducing items, all of which require either the Fevor's Cookbook [1] or Fevor's Cookbook [2].
